args.query: SELECT id, name FROM account WHERE org_id = 'org_indian_demo' AND type @> ARRAY['BANK']::text[]

sql_queries.sql: SELECT id, name FROM account WHERE org_id = 'org_indian_demo' AND type @> ARRAY['BANK']::text[]
sql_queries.description: Finds all accounts classified as banking accounts.

args.query: SELECT a.id AS account_id, a.name AS account_name, SUM(p.amount) AS total_spending FROM posting p JOIN account a ON p.credit_account_id = a.id WHERE p.org_id = 'org_indian_demo' AND a.type @> ARRAY['BANK']::text[] GROUP BY a.id, a.name ORDER BY total_spending DESC
args.description: Calculates the total spending for each banking account.
